� FB Real Property Services � Discover all our services at: fbrealproperty. com

� COMMERCIAL PREMISES OF 69.86m2 Divided into two floors:

Floor 0 (Street level): 30.66m2
Floor -1: 39.2m2 (Access via stairs, includes 3m2 restroom)

⚠️ ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENT: Documentation justifying income equivalent to 3 times the rent amount is required. Failing that: Guarantor, bank guarantee, or rental default insurance.

It is essential to certify the activity that will be carried out.

� NECESSARY DOCUMENTATION

� If you have a business (Company):

- Articles of incorporation and company tax ID (NIF).
- Corporate Tax, Forms 190 and 390.
- Certificates of being up to date with payments (Tax Agency and Social Security).
- ID of the Representative.

� Employees:

- ID.
- Employment contract and last 3 payslips.
- Last Income Tax Return.
- Updated employment history report (vida laboral).

� Self-employed:

- ID.
- Last Income Tax Return.
- Forms 303 and 130 (current year).
- Updated employment history report (vida laboral).

� New business:

- ID.
- Proof of solvency (bank statement, guarantees, capitalized unemployment benefits, etc. ).

� CONTRACT CONDITIONS

⏳ Duration:
- 5 years (negotiable).

� Price:
€750/month + VAT for the first 2 years.
€1,000/month + VAT for the following 3 years.

� At signing:
- 1 Current month.
- 3 Months deposit.
- 10% of one year's rent + VAT (agency fees).
- €100 utility deposit.

�️ VIEWINGS
- Monday to Friday from 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM.
- Outside these hours, it will be subject to the agent's availability.

� SUBMISSION OF DOCUMENTATION

Web request: Send a request through this portal and reply to our automated email.

Direct E-mail: (Indicate property address, activity to be carried out, and total number of people/partners).

In-person (Offices): Monday to Friday from 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM.
